name: akroma, vision of ixidor
mana cost: {5}{W}{W}
types: legendary creature angel
power toughness: 6/6
static: flying
static: first strike
static: vigilance
static: trample
static: partner
triggered: at the beginning of each combat, until end of turn, each other creature you control gets +1/+1 if it has flying, +1/+1 if it has first strike, and so on for double strike, deathtouch, haste, hexproof, indestructible, lifelink, menace, protection, reach, trample, vigilance, and partner.
